Game Overview

In Astro Hoops, the core idea is straightforward: zoom through the cosmos in Astro Hoops, where precision flying and quick reflexes are key. Navigate glowing rings, dodge obstacles, and rack up points as speed intensifies. Unlock quirky pilots for a personalized adventure. Easy to start, tough to conquer—how long can you keep flying?
